t: All American Museum Collections Are For Sale, Just Make An Offer
s: April 1, 2020 - Having long studied how American museums remove (deaccession) collections, I now believe that everything they own can be bought. To be sure, price tags don't appear on exhibited paintings, dinosaur fossils or antique artifacts. But given the unremitting and exploding practice of commercially discarding things, anyone desiring what they see displayed or know lurks in museum storage should, in the United States at least, feel comfortable making a purchase offer.
